name: Veiled Chain
body:
Source Inner Sea Gods pg. 253
Aura faint illusion CL 3rd
Slot armor; Price 4,490 gp; Weight 25 lbs.
Description
Narrow strips of brilliant silk cloth are woven through the rings of this +1 chain shirt that cause the armor’s colors to shift and shimmer as its wearer moves. The wearer can use disguise self and vanishAPG each once per day.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, disguise self, vanishAPG; Price 2,370 gp
